text:
Maya CSM: Quick idea — piloting a "cohort bridging" play for mid-market accounts hitting a usage dip. I want a low-friction 'downgrade jump' option: short-term downgraded plan + 1:1 enablement + feedback capture. Thoughts?

Sam (CS Ops): +1. Need clear trigger criteria. Suggest: 7-day rolling DAU drop >=30% OR missed 2 consecutive onboarding milestones AND renewal within 90 days. Auto-trigger the playbook.

OnboardBot: Trigger fired: cohort_bridge_rule_7 for account 'VeloxHR' (id: acct_984). Play instance created: bridge_1945006789_1.

Jordan (AE): For mid-market, pricing + finance matters. Recommend a 3-month bridge at 40% off (auto-renews to original plan unless customer opts out) and an upsell check at month 2. Need AE notification and revenue ops sign-off.

Leila (Product): Product can ship a "micro-onboard" kit to support enablement: 20-min tailored session + templated SDK snippet and a short admin checklist. Example deploy call:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/bridge -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d @micro_onboard.json
```
This keeps tech friction down.

Maya CSM: Key constraints: must not mark the account as churned in our metrics, re-upgrade should be one-click from the console, and we need to capture 2 discrete exit reasons to inform product. Also avoid full legal promo for small discounts.

Sam (CS Ops): I'll draft an automated workflow and a short opt-in email + in-app CTA. Draft checklist I plan to automate: 
- Identify eligible cohort and tag accounts
- Send outreach with bridge offer + quick opt-in
- Schedule 1:1 enablement (20 min) via calendar link
- Provision downgrade-jump config (limit time window)
- Post-session quick feedback form (3 Qs)
- Route flagged accounts (pay/tech/legal) to AE for follow-up
I'll also add a metric: bridge_reactivate_rate and report weekly.

Jordan (AE): Add finance and legal for the promo T&Cs. Also include an AE follow-up template to reduce friction on renewal.

Maya CSM: Pilot scope — 10 accounts next week, mid-market segment with renewal in next 90 days. Goal: reduce churn risk by 30% vs control and capture top 3 exit reasons.

Sam (CS Ops): I'll create the play instance, wire up OnboardBot triggers, and post the playbook doc link here once ready. Planning to tag the first 10 accounts today. :thumbsup:

Leila (Product): I'll prepare the micro-onboard assets + a 2-slide product reminder for the enablement session.

Maya CSM: Thanks all — please add any missing steps. Once Sam posts the playbook link we'll run the pilot and sync in the follow-up retro. @Jordan please prep the AE template.
